description: Set the damping scheme used by the structural elements for static analysis (see Mechanical Damping ). The following keywords are available:

description.7.0: sets the damping scheme used by the structural element logic to combined-local damping. The local damping factor is f1 with the default value 0.8.
description.9.0: combined damping. The combined damping factor is f1 .

description.7.0: sets the damping scheme used by the structural element logic to local damping. This is the default setting for static mode . The local damping factor is f1 with the default value 0.8.
description.9.0: local damping. This is the default setting for static mode . The local damping factor is f1 with the default value 0.8.
